description_en: Queries the details of your domain name assets
description_zh: 查询您的域名资产的详情
name: DescribeDomainDetail

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the access source
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The name of the domain name or website to query.

Fuzzy match is not supported. Enter the complete domain name or website name
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的域名或网站的名称。

不支持模糊查询，您需要输入完整的域名或网站名称
parameters.name: domain_name

AlarmCount.description_en: The total number of alerts in your website assets
AlarmCount.description_zh: 您网站资产中的告警的总数量

DomainDetailItems.description_en: The asset information related to the domain name

AssetType.description_en:
The Asset Type of the asset under the domain name. Valid values:

0: ECS
1: load balancing
2: NAT gateway
3: RDS database
4: MongoDB database
AssetType.description_zh:
域名下资产的资产类型。取值包括：

0：ECS
1：负载均衡
2：NAT网关
3：RDS数据库
4：MongoDB数据库

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the asset

InternetIp.description_en: The public IP address of the asset
InternetIp.description_zh: 资产对应的公网的IP地址

IntranetIp.description_en: The private IP address of the asset
IntranetIp.description_zh: 资产对应的私网的IP地址

Uuid.description_en: The UUID of the asset instance

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. The China value is a unique identifier that Alibaba Cloud generates for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

RootDomain.description_en: The root domain name that corresponds to the domain name
RootDomain.description_zh: 域名对应的根域名的名称

VulCount.description_en: The total number of vulnerabilities in your website assets
VulCount.description_zh: 您网站资产中的漏洞的总数量
